name: refute_counters_then_draws_and_discards
notes: Printed: 'Counter target spell. Draw a card, then discard a card.' Seat 0 casts Savannah Lions; seat 1 answers with Refute ({1}{U}{U}): the Lions are countered, seat 1 draws one card (Library 5, the top filler) and then discards one card of its choice, here the Spare it held (hand: Spare -> Spare + Library 5 -> Library 5).
